# Bundled libraries

Copied unmodified from npm so PDF export, operator forms and .zip import work offline and inside the native apps.

| File | Package | License |
|---|---|---|
| pdf-lib.min.js | pdf-lib 1.17.1 | MIT |
| fontkit.umd.min.js | @pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1 | MIT |
| jspdf.umd.min.js | jspdf 2.5.1 | MIT |
| jszip.min.js | jszip 3.10.1 | MIT (dual MIT / GPLv3, used under MIT) |
| fonts/Lato-Regular.ttf, fonts/Lato-Bold.ttf | lato-font 3.0.0 (WOFF converted to TTF for PDF embedding) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| fonts/roboto-*.woff2, fonts/roboto-mono-*.woff2 | @fontsource/roboto 5, @fontsource/roboto-mono 5 | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| fonts/material-symbols-rounded.woff2 | material-symbols | Apache License 2.0 |
